model: two-body bound: floor(spread+fee+funding) + decoupled daily-basis sqrt impact-tail
v3_planned: Reemplaza el acople de ancla-unica v2 por dos cuerpos desacoplados. Futuro: sigma_daily rolling por simbolo; ESTIMADOR empirico de costo separado (epic distinto, vive AL LADO de esta cota, nunca la reemplaza).

sources.model_choice_v3: Two-body upper bound (NOT an estimator). The cost model is an intentional conservative ceiling, falsifiable but not fit to live. Body = floor (spread+fee+funding), size-independent, the dominant cost at operating sizes. Guardrail = decoupled sqrt impact tail (Toth 2011 PRX 1:021006; Donier-Bonart 2015 MM&L 1(02); Almgren-Chriss 2001), reserved for the metaorder regime where the sqrt law actually applies. Replaces v2 single-anchor coupling. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-02-cost-model-v3-design.md.
sources.floor: FLOOR_bps[tier] = stress_mult*(2*half_spread + 2*fee_per_side) + funding(holding_hours). Size-INDEPENDENT, the dominant bound in the operating regime. Calibrated independently and conservatively to public Binance USDT-M perp facts; NOT fit to live realized P&L. RT floor: major 13.0, mid 18.0, small 30.0 bps.
sources.fee_bps_per_side: 5.0 = Binance USDT-M perp STANDARD published taker fee (0.05%), no VIP/BNB/maker discount. Exact deterministic cost, NO cushion. v2 used 10.0 (a non-physical inflation); v3 removes it. The published taker fee also serves as the model-independent mandatory lower bound in the falsification harness.
sources.half_spread_bps: Conservative quartile of public Binance USDT-M perp top-of-book spread, rounded up over typical: BTC/ETH ~0.1bps typical -> 1.5 (UNCHANGED from v2: major was already at the perp quartile, no spot cushion to strip); mid ~1-4 -> 4.0 and small ~5-10 -> 10.0 (LOWERED from v2's 7.5/15, which carried a non-physical spot cushion for perps). So only mid/small dropped; major is identical to v2. Each stays above the typical perp spread, so still a bound.
sources.funding_rate_bps_per_8h: Value unchanged from v2 (conservative absolute estimate per 8h interval, floor semantics). Structurally ZERO in the operating regime (mean hold 5.3h -> floor(5.3/8)=0); an add-on that only fires on holds >=8h. NOTE: the LRC path now prices funding in v3 (v2 LRC excluded it), so v2-priced LRC numbers are not funding-comparable.
sources.stress_mult: Operator pessimism dial for stress-replay runs (LUNA/FTX). Default 1.0 — and ships INERT: nothing in this PR sets it >1 (the stress-replay coupling is a separate epic). CONSEQUENCE: the bound is NOT yet demonstrated crisis-survivable; that claim waits until the stress-replay harness pulls this lever. It is the only lever that widens the bound under a volatility/liquidity event (no body responds to sigma on its own). NOT fit to data. When a stress-replay run uses it, it must set it explicitly (>1) or refuse to run.
sources.impact_tail: tail_bps_per_fill = Y * sigma_daily_bps * sqrt(order_usd / (liquidity_usd_per_min * 1440)). DAILY participation basis (the ~38x base correction vs v2's per-minute). sigma_daily_bps {major 300, mid 500, small 800} is a STATIC conservative fallback for launch; a rolling 30d per-symbol sigma is a fast-follow. The tail is inert (floor-dominated) at the ~$644 average trade and a real guardrail for large fills in thin alts. Total tail reduction vs v2 at Y=1.5 is ~65-75x = sqrt(1440)=37.95x (base) x ~1.7-2.0x (slope source change size_factor -> Y*sigma).
sources.Y_impact_constant: 1.5 = top of the empirical O(1) band (0.3-1.5; Toth 2011, Donier-Bonart 2015). Fixed by TYPE COHERENCE, not preference: a bound errs upward, so only the upper edge of the band preserves the bound type; a central Y would make the tail a central estimate wearing a bound label.
sources.total_cost_cap_bps: 1000.0 = total round-trip cap (re-spec: v2's 500 was applied per-leg, never a total ceiling). Above the plausible worst-case event slippage; an explicit backtest-pessimism backstop, NOT a physical 5%-adverse claim. Stress widening lives in stress_mult, not the cap.

sensitivity_note: Floor = operating-regime bound (size-indep), dominant cost at ~$644. Tail inert (floor-dominated) ONLY at the average trade; a real guardrail in participation 1e-3..1e-1 for large fills in thin alts; co-dominant for small at backtest notional. Bound guarantee rests on non-negativity + total-cost cap + stress_mult, NOT on floor>tail dominance. stress_mult + per-symbol sigma are the volatility levers. v2 numbers are frozen in costs_calibration.v2.json for parity tests.
